title: What the Spotted Cuscus keeps

is_this_you.pressure: Pushed, you go still and hold the branch. Cross into your tree twice and you stand up and bark.
is_this_you.love: You let one person onto your platform. After that you know what they need before they ask.
is_this_you.cost: You keep a reserve high up for a storm that keeps not coming, and you go without in the meantime.

opener.text: Travellers have looked up at the spotted cuscus and taken it for a sloth or another possum, and sometimes for a monkey [s5]. You were born in the Monkey's year, so that mistake lands close to the truth. The cleverness is real. It simply moves slowly, and mostly after dark [s5]. Cancer is ruled by the Moon [s1]. So the people who finally see you clearly tend to see you by night, from a branch or two away.

howto: Three parts. Take them slowly, one branch at a time.

tabs.label: Slow
tabs.intro: Water that keeps. Metal that thinks.

rows.text: Cancer is cardinal Water, protective and hospitable, loyal over the long run [s1] [s2]. It also withdraws when hurt and holds on to old wounds [s2]. The Monkey is yang Metal, quick and inventive [s3] [s4]. In you the quick mind works for the keeping side. You think fast and move slowly, and only the people closest to you notice the gap.

The spotted cuscus moves slowly through the trees, gripping with a long tail that is bare and rough underneath [s5] [s6]. It has also been seen walking between trees, and it can gallop [s6]. So the slowness is a choice. You test a branch twice, and then you hold it with everything you have.

tabs.label: Mistaken
tabs.intro: Plain from far off. Marked up close.

rows.text: Only the male is spotted, with marks from red-brown to grey on a pale coat [s5] [s6]. Females are usually plain white or grey [s5] [s6]. Your detail stays private until someone climbs close. Mostly you like it that way.

A male cuscus marks his trees with musk and saliva [s5]. When another male comes in, he barks and hisses and stands upright to defend the ground [s5]. People read your softness as an easy yes. The bark surprises them every time.

Use the Monkey mind for checking and the Cancer heart for keeping. Night care suits you, and so do archives, museum collections and audit work. So would a small guesthouse, with you still awake after the guests have gone to bed.

tabs.label: Who sees your spots
tabs.intro: Three who climb close enough. One who shakes the tree.
tabs.love_lead: Cancer guards the people it loves for years [s2]. The Monkey needs play, or it gets bored [s3] [s4]. So your partner has to be patient with your nights and funny in your mornings. The old pairings name three.

easy.why: The Slow Loris (Scorpio, Snake year) is your secret friend, since the Snake is the Monkey's hidden ally, and Scorpio is Water like you [s3] [s1].
The Humpback Whale (Cancer, Dragon year) shares your trine of Rat, Dragon and Monkey, and was born under your sign [s3].
The Vampire Squid (Pisces, Rat year) is trine kin through the Rat, and Pisces is the third Water sign [s3] [s1].

hard.why: The Steller's Sea Eagle (Capricorn, Tiger year) pulls against you twice: the Tiger clashes with the Monkey, and Capricorn sits opposite Cancer [s3] [s1].

story.text: The spotted cuscus on Selayar, off Sulawesi, is the most isolated population of its kind [s7]. Heinsohn thinks Austronesian boats probably carried it there in the late Holocene [s7]. Somebody made room for it on board.

closing: Let someone carry you across the water. You will make a home wherever the boat comes ashore.
